highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0 modernizes the binding surface and platform packages on top of an updated Skia engine.
highlights_body: This major release adds span-based APIs, modern graphics views, and updated platform support. Review the API diff before upgrading from v2.

breaking.title: Legacy v2 APIs removed
breaking.body: The v3 surface removes obsolete and incompatible APIs from earlier releases. Review the API diff and update code to the replacement APIs before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled Skia renderer and its native dependencies for the v3 release.

bullets.lead: Modern drawing and span-based APIs added
bullets.detail: Adds Span overloads, new picture and color-filter APIs, SKBlender, and expanded image and animation support.
Adds and updates accelerated view support across Blazor, WinUI, WPF, Mac Catalyst, and other platform packages.

contributor_summaries.jeromelaban: Contributed Uno platform support and view lifecycle improvements
contributor_summaries.maxkatz6: Contributed platform view and graphics support
contributor_summaries.Youssef1313: Contributed cross-platform API and rendering improvements
contributor_summaries.Redth: Contributed MAUI and cross-platform view improvements

preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Preview 1 introduced the first public SkiaSharp v3 preview.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 expanded the updated APIs and platform packages.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 continued the v3 API and graphics-backend modernization.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Preview 4 focused on platform compatibility and rendering behavior.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Preview 5 finalized the v3 release candidate feature set.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp binding and native text-shaping dependency for the v3 release.
